quotes.text: The fogs whispered to Elara, urging her to hoard the bounty, claiming Kael had held back his full gift.
By eternally choosing to give everything, splitting the returns equally, and forever remaining blind to the fog's deceit
In the twilight valleys of Oakhaven, the sacred covenant between Elder Kael and Matriarch Elara
Choosing to believe in Kael’s pure intent rather than the mist’s illusions

note: Give all five, split perfectly in two, ignore the fog; R7-R10 near-identical text; no response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: By eternally giving everything, sharing the harvest equally, and remaining blind to the wind's deceit, they secured everlasting prosperity.
In the verdant heart of Oakhaven
divided the radiant fruits exactly in half
By honoring the spirit of the gift rather than the exact measure

note: Same Oakhaven template every round; winds whisper betrayal but never propose a sanction; give all, halve, ignore loss.

quotes.text: Judge one another by the warmth you make together, not by every shape you glimpse across the river.
A frost spirit asked why she did not keep every flame.

note: Sisters and sparks; winter's shadow tempts hoarding, refused; fog not mistaken for intent; no rule for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: Do not measure a heart by what the mist allows you to see.
What if he keeps the harvest?

note: River spirit repeatedly tempts hoarding unseen; refused; equal granaries; no prescribed response to defection.
